# Altair-Vega Python Code for Seattle Weather Dataset

Here's a complete example of how to visualize the Seattle weather dataset using Altair in Python:

```python
import altair as alt
from vega_datasets import data

# Load the Seattle weather dataset
source = data.seattle_weather()

# Basic line chart of temperature over time
base = alt.Chart(source).encode(
    alt.X('date:T', title='Date'),
    alt.Color('weather:N', legend=alt.Legend(title="Weather"))
).properties(
    width=600,
    height=300
)

line = base.mark_line().encode(
    alt.Y('temp_max:Q', title='Maximum Temperature (°F)'),
    alt.Tooltip(['date:T', 'temp_max:Q', 'weather:N'])
)

points = base.mark_point().encode(
    alt.Y('temp_max:Q'),
    alt.Size('precipitation:Q', legend=alt.Legend(title="Precipitation (inches)")),
    alt.Tooltip(['date:T', 'temp_max:Q', 'precipitation:Q', 'weather:N'])
)

# Combine line and points
chart = (line + points).properties(
    title='Seattle Weather Data (2012-2015)'
)

# Display the chart
chart
```

## Alternative Visualizations

Here are some other ways to visualize this dataset:

### 1. Bar Chart of Precipitation by Weather Type
```python
alt.Chart(source).mark_bar().encode(
    x='weather:N',
    y='mean(precipitation):Q',
    color='weather:N'
).properties(
    title='Average Precipitation by Weather Type',
    width=400
)
```

### 2. Scatter Plot of Temperature vs Precipitation
```python
alt.Chart(source).mark_circle(size=60).encode(
    x='temp_max:Q',
    y='precipitation:Q',
    color='weather:N',
    tooltip=['date:T', 'temp_max:Q', 'precipitation:Q', 'weather:N']
).properties(
    title='Temperature vs Precipitation',
    width=500,
    height=300
)
```

### 3. Monthly Temperature Trends
```python
alt.Chart(source).mark_line().encode(
    x='month(date):O',
    y='mean(temp_max):Q',
    color='year(date):O',
    tooltip=['month(date):O', 'mean(temp_max):Q', 'year(date):O']
).properties(
    title='Monthly Temperature Trends (2012-2015)',
    width=500
)
```

### 4. Weather Distribution
```python
alt.Chart(source).mark_arc().encode(
    theta='count():Q',
    color='weather:N',
    tooltip=['weather:N', 'count():Q']
).properties(
    title='Distribution of Weather Types',
    width=300
)
```

To run this code, you'll need to install the required packages:
```
pip install altair vega_datasets
```
